ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface estimated at 85-90% with localized high-intensity (white) patches on lateral tips and isolated focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white contiguous blobs located on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. A distinct circular high-intensity spot is present in the medial-lateral zone of the left lobe. High-intensity mottling is observed along the inferior margin partially occluded by water splash.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the superior boundary with low-amplitude peaks and valleys; notable V-shaped indentation located on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 20% from the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the superior edges of both lobes extending toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular high-contrast pixel groups on the far lateral edges (tips) of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the superior region of the right lobe near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent isolated circular white scar located on the mid-ventral surface of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense accumulation of barnacle-like structures on the extreme vertical lateral boundaries of both lobes.
